panel_description_zh: 中景平视，客卧床头柜上的电子闹钟，绿色数字显示 07:45 略微过曝；旁边半空玻璃水杯、白色充电线盘成圈；浅景深，时钟清晰背景虚化。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: MC 鲁迅
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 记录了他婚前一整天的生活。

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium close-up with shallow depth of field on a small round LED alarm clock sitting on a plain wooden nightstand. The clock screen glows green and clearly reads 07:45, the digits slightly overexposed for emphasis. Beside the clock: a half-empty clear glass of water and a white charging cable neatly coiled into a circle. Background wood grain of the nightstand softly blurred. Cool blue-grey ambient bedroom light, the clock screen is the only warm green light source. Text watermark 'P01-PN02' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: people in frame, anime style, smartphone showing the time instead of a clock, watches or wristwatches, daylight streaming in, decorative bed frame in view, romantic bedroom mood
